commitments.detail: An independent convener will be appointed; no existing co-chair from either ERG may solely chair combined meetings; facilitated joint sessions will be provided to address unresolved conflicts.
A written charter must be produced for the combined arrangement before launch.
A formal review of the combined arrangement will be conducted after exactly 90 days.
Combined meetings will start no later than 2:00 p.m. and will provide recordings and asynchronous access for participants who need them.
Before the merged program launches, each existing ERG must conduct a separate opt-in vote with approval from at least two-thirds of voting members in each group.
